Belimo.why: Supplies control valves (Energy Valve), actuators and sensors for data-center liquid-cooling loops; data centers were about 23%-24% of H1 2026 sales and over half of its absolute growth, mostly liquid cooling via the control-valve line.
Belimo.evidence: Belimo Q2 FY2026 (07-20-2026), CFO: 'Most of the data center growth is attributed to liquid cooling and is therefore recognized on the control valve business line.'

players.product: control valves (incl. stainless steel Energy Valve), actuators and sensors for data-center liquid-cooling loops

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results: sales CHF 676 million, up 29.6% in local currency (volume and mix 22.3%, pricing 7.3%) and 20.5% in Swiss francs after a 9.2% FX headwind; EBIT up 19% to CHF 153 million, a 22.5% margin; net income up 23% to CHF 125 million. Americas CHF 341 million (+35% local currency), EMEA CHF 240 million (+14%), Asia-Pacific +58% in local currency. Control valves (58% of sales) +48% in local currency, damper actuators +8%, sensors and meters close to +40%. Return on capital employed 41%, equity ratio 61%.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 sales CHF 676 million (+29.6% local currency); EBIT CHF 153 million (22.5%); net income CHF 125 million

quarterly_data.signal: Data centers accounted for a bit more than half of absolute sales growth in H1 2026 and about 23%-24% of group sales, up from 18% in H2 2025; most of the data-center growth comes from liquid cooling and is booked in the control-valve line, with the Energy Valve as flagship. Data centers were more than half of Americas growth; the US data-center share is in the range of 30%, and Asia-Pacific grew on OEMs building data-center equipment for export. CFO: data-center share of sales is expected to keep rising.
quarterly_data.figure: data centers ~23%-24% of H1 sales (18% in H2 2025)

quarterly_data.signal: CFO: liquid cooling is becoming the standard - most US data-center sales are now liquid-cooled, Asia-Pacific has more air cooling and EMEA the least liquid; hyperscalers drive the high-end builds while some co-locators are moving into liquid cooling (sometimes rear-door rather than direct-to-chip). Belimo has ample capacity; the limit is project deployment - order entry is rising across the industry but deployment lags because of execution speed and available power, with no stocking. The market remains roughly CHF 40 million-CHF 60 million per gigawatt; value per rack rises with heat density. Belimo is the technology leader with first-mover advantages; competitors are entering as second sources, and management expects current stainless steel technology to remain the winning technology versus emerging polymer valves.

Belimo's first data-center-only product, a fully stainless steel Energy Valve for liquid cooling developed with hyperscalers and the data-center industry, is being introduced in the second half of 2026; CFO: it is a higher-end, mix-accretive product. A US data-center experience center is opening.

Outlook: quantitative full-year revenue guidance withdrawn because of uncertainty over the pace of data-center deployment, to return when visibility improves; continued very strong demand and growth expected in H2, at a lower relative rate than H1 due to base effects and a smaller pricing contribution; H2 EBIT margin expected above 20%. Capex in H2 expected similar to H1, with similar elevated levels in 2027 and 2028 for capacity expansion in Hinwil and the US.
